# RebindRise — AI Engineering & Full Stack Bootcamp

## About

RebindRise is a premium in-person AI Engineering & Java Full Stack bootcamp based in Hinjawadi, Pune, India.
It is a product of Mutex Software Innovations Private Limited.

Website: https://rebindrise.com
Email: hello@rebind.in
Phone: +91 9156929220
Location: Hinjawadi, Pune, Maharashtra, India

## What We Offer

RebindRise runs two flagship programs:

### 1. Agentic AI Engineering Bootcamp
A 10-week weekend bootcamp teaching engineers to build production-ready AI systems from scratch.

Topics covered:
- LLM integration and prompt engineering
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
- Tool calling and function-calling agents
- Agentic AI architecture and multi-agent systems
- AI application deployment and production practices
- Capstone project: "AI Engineering Assistant" — a fully deployed AI product

### 2. Java Full Stack Development Course
A comprehensive training covering:
- Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, JPA, Hibernate ORM
- Frontend integration

## Key Facts

- Batch size: Maximum 25 students per cohort
- Format: In-person (Hinjawadi, Pune) + online access
- Schedule: Weekends only — Saturday & Sunday (4–5 hours per day)
- Next batch: 15 June 2026
- Suitable for: Working engineers who want to upskill in AI without quitting their job
- Prerequisites: Basic programming knowledge; no prior AI/ML experience needed
- Hardware: Any laptop with 8 GB RAM (Windows, macOS, or Linux)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who is this bootcamp for?
A: Software engineers who want to build real-world AI systems, RAG pipelines, and AI agents — not just use AI tools.

Q: Is this online or in-person?
A: Primarily in-person in Pune, with online access so students never fall behind.

Q: Can I join while working full-time?
A: Yes. Sessions are on weekends only (Saturday & Sunday), designed for working professionals.

Q: What will I build?
A: A production-deployed "AI Engineering Assistant" as a capstone project, plus weekly hands-on builds throughout the program.

Q: What is the refund policy?
A: Full refund within 7 days of payment if the cohort has not started. Non-refundable after cohort begins.
